title: The Heretic's Bonfire
text: The Court's zealots are burning books in the square, whole libraries going up in a roaring pyre, pages curling like black leaves into the sky. The crowd cheers. A young novice beside you is weeping, and she slips a single torn page into your hands.

options.label: The wisest reads the novice's page, before the zealots see it.

outcomes.text: It is a lost rite of the Six, half burned but still holy. It warms the hands that hold it.

options.label: Pull books from the fire, whatever the zealots may think.

outcomes.text: The zealots turn on you, faces lit orange, as the crowd stops cheering.

options.label: Throw the page into the fire too. It is safer that way.

outcomes.text: The zealots bless you loudly. The novice never looks at you again, and beyond the Gate something is pleased.
